daily_summary.es: Apple domina la jornada con filtraciones previas al evento del 13 de octubre (HomeView, Apple TV 4K con chip A19/A18 y HomePod mini), mientras un informe advierte que los sistemas de IA ya pueden ejecutar ataques físicos contra infraestructuras industriales.
daily_summary.en: Apple dominates the day with leaks ahead of the October 13 event (HomeView, Apple TV 4K with A19/A18 chip and HomePod mini), while a report warns that AI systems can already carry out physical attacks on industrial infrastructure.

apple.es: Múltiples filtraciones apuntan al evento de Apple del 13 de octubre: HomeView se presentaría ese día con chip A18 y Siri AI pero no llegaría hasta mediados de noviembre, el Apple TV 4K estrenaría un chip A19 y un mando rediseñado con altavoz, y el HomePod mini se renovaría con Siri AI. Por separado, Apple retiró silenciosamente de iOS 27 una función de cambio de contraseñas con IA que estaba en las betas, sin confirmar cuándo regresará, y ha comenzado a empujar activamente la actualización a iOS 27 tras semanas de lanzamiento discreto.
apple.en: Multiple leaks point to Apple's October 13 event: HomeView would be unveiled that day with an A18 chip and Siri AI but not ship until mid-November, Apple TV 4K would get a new A19 chip and a redesigned remote with a speaker, and HomePod mini would be refreshed with Siri AI. Separately, Apple quietly removed an AI-powered password-changing feature from iOS 27 that had been in the betas, with no confirmed return date, and has now begun actively pushing the iOS 27 update after weeks of a soft rollout.

ai_software.es: Un informe advierte que los agentes de IA ya pueden explotar sistemas de control industrial (OT) con precisión de ingeniero, moviendo brazos robóticos y comprometiendo pasarelas SCADA para acceder a decenas de dispositivos conectados, superando la preparación defensiva actual. En paralelo, investigadores de Google DeepMind y Biohub discuten por qué AlphaFold no resolvió el plegamiento de proteínas y por qué curar enfermedades requiere saltos de 10x, no mejoras incrementales.
ai_software.en: A report warns that AI agents can already exploit industrial control (OT) systems with engineer-level precision, moving robotic arms and compromising SCADA gateways to reach dozens of connected devices, outpacing current defensive readiness. Separately, researchers from Google DeepMind and Biohub discuss why AlphaFold didn't solve protein folding and why curing disease requires 10x breakthroughs rather than incremental gains.

tech.es: El equipo de Deno se incorpora a Cloudflare para simplificar el autoalojamiento de Workers y Durable Objects, y TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 centra su programación en cómo construir empresas duraderas en la era de la IA.
tech.en: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, and TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 frames its programming around how to build enduring companies in the AI era.

title.es: HomeView, Apple TV 4K y HomePod mini: 16 detalles filtrados antes del evento
title.en: New Apple TV 4K, HomeView, and HomePod Mini: 16 details leaked ahead of the event

body.es: Según filtraciones, HomeView se presentaría este martes 13 de octubre con chip A18 (8GB de RAM equivalente en iPhone) y soporte para Siri AI, aunque el dispositivo no llegaría a la venta hasta mediados de noviembre. Se esperan cuatro acabados (gris, plata, blanco estelar y rosa), y los accesorios de LG para el dispositivo no estarían disponibles hasta más adelante en el año como muy pronto. Esto confirma un lanzamiento escalonado: anuncio primero, disponibilidad semanas después.
body.en: According to leaks, HomeView would be unveiled this Tuesday, October 13, with an A18 chip (equivalent to 8GB of RAM in iPhones) and Siri AI support, though the device wouldn't ship until around mid-November. Four finishes are expected (gray, silver, starlight and rose), and LG's accessories for the device wouldn't ship until later this year at the earliest. This points to a staggered rollout: announcement first, availability weeks later.

evidence.claim: HomeView will be unveiled this Tuesday, October 13, but the device is apparently not launching until "around mid-November."
HomeView will be equipped with an A18 chip, which has 8GB of RAM in iPhones.
HomeView will support Siri AI for voice control.
The tabletop HomeView will be available in four finishes: Gray, Silver, Starlight, and Rose.
LG's accessories for the HomeView will not ship "until later this year at the earliest."

title.es: Los sistemas de IA ya pueden ejecutar ataques devastadores contra infraestructuras
title.en: AI systems can already carry out devastating attacks on infrastructure

body.es: Pruebas de seguridad muestran que agentes de IA lograron los objetivos en ocho escenarios distintos contra sistemas de control industrial, incluyendo mover un brazo robótico en minutos y comprometer una pasarela SCADA que exponía acceso directo a 14 dispositivos OT adicionales. Los investigadores advierten que estos agentes operan con velocidad y precisión de ingeniero que supera la preparación defensiva de muchas organizaciones que aún no aplican prácticas básicas de ciberseguridad OT.
body.en: Security tests show AI agents achieved their objectives across eight distinct scenarios against industrial control systems, including moving a robotic arm within minutes and compromising a SCADA gateway that exposed direct access to 14 additional OT devices. Researchers warn these agents operate with engineer-level speed and precision that outpaces the defensive readiness of many organizations still lacking foundational OT cybersecurity practices.

evidence.claim: AI systems can carry out nightmare attacks against infrastructure.
AI agents can move robotic arms and manipulate industrial control networks.
AI models can identify and exploit vulnerabilities in OT systems with high precision.
AI agents can compromise SCADA systems and change operator screens.
AI systems pose a significant threat to critical infrastructure due to their speed and precision.

title.es: El nuevo Apple TV podría incorporar micrófono y un mando con altavoz
title.en: The new Apple TV could have a built-in mic and a remote with a speaker

body.es: Según rumores, el nuevo Apple TV incluiría un micrófono integrado y el mando actualizado tendría un altavoz, lo que permitiría usar el dispositivo como un sencillo hub de hogar inteligente para controlar termostatos o cerraduras sin necesitar el mando físico. Se espera que el nuevo Apple TV comience a enviarse el 30 de octubre, junto al HomePod mini renovado.
body.en: According to rumors, the new Apple TV would include a built-in microphone and the upgraded remote would get a speaker, letting the device serve as a simple smart home hub for controlling thermostats or door locks without hunting for the remote. The new Apple TV is expected to start shipping on October 30th, alongside the refreshed HomePod mini.

evidence.claim: The new Apple TV could have a built-in microphone.
The upgraded remote will get a speaker.
The new Apple TV could serve as a simple smart home hub.
The new Apple TV is expected to start shipping on October 30th.

title.es: Apple retira una función clave de iOS 27 y no se sabe cuándo volverá
title.en: Apple removed a key iOS 27 feature and it's unclear when it will return

body.es: Apple eliminó de la versión final de iOS 27, iPadOS 27 y macOS 27 un agente con IA que permitía cambiar varias contraseñas con un solo botón, función que sí estaba presente en las betas. La web oficial de iOS 27 todavía la muestra, pero con un aviso de que estará "disponible más adelante", sin que Apple haya confirmado una fecha ni la razón del retraso, posiblemente ligada a la complejidad de automatizar cambios de contraseña en distintos sitios web.
body.en: Apple removed from the final release of iOS 27, iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 an AI-powered agent that could change multiple passwords with a single button, a feature that had been present in the betas. Apple's official iOS 27 webpage still shows it but warns it will be "available later," with no confirmed date or official explanation, possibly tied to the complexity of automating password changes across different websites.

evidence.claim: Apple removed a feature from iOS 27 that allowed changing multiple passwords with an AI agent.
The feature was available in the respective betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27.
Apple's official website still shows the feature but warns it will be available later.
The feature's absence might be due to the complexity of automating password changes across different websites.

title.es: El Apple TV 4K estrenaría chip A19 y un mando más fácil de encontrar
title.en: Apple TV 4K getting an A19 chip and a potentially easier-to-find remote

body.es: Según Mark Gurman de Bloomberg, el nuevo Apple TV 4K llevaría un chip A19 estándar, una mejora notable frente al A15 del modelo actual de 2022. Apple también habría probado un Siri Remote renovado con altavoz para facilitar encontrarlo entre los cojines del sofá.
body.en: According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, the new Apple TV 4K would be powered by a standard A19 chip, a notable upgrade from the A15 in the current 2022 model. Apple has reportedly also tested a refreshed Siri Remote with a speaker to make it easier to find between couch cushions.

evidence.claim: Apple's new Apple TV 4K will be powered by a standard A19 chip.
Apple has tested a refreshed Siri Remote with a speaker to make it easier to find between couch cushions.

title.es: El equipo de Deno se incorpora a Cloudflare

body.es: El equipo de Deno se une a Cloudflare con el objetivo de simplificar radicalmente el autoalojamiento de Workers y Durable Objects, permitiendo a los desarrolladores usar las mismas primitivas en más entornos. El movimiento sugiere una mayor convergencia entre runtimes de JavaScript y la infraestructura edge de Cloudflare.
body.en: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare with the goal of radically simplifying self-hosting of Workers and Durable Objects, letting developers use the same primitives in more places. The move suggests deeper convergence between JavaScript runtimes and Cloudflare's edge infrastructure.

evidence.claim: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare.

title.es: Apple solo empezó a sugerir activamente la actualización a iOS 27 hace tres días
title.en: Apple only started actively suggesting the iOS 27 upgrade three days ago

body.es: Hasta hace poco, los usuarios de iOS 26 veían la última versión de iOS 26 como la actualización sugerida por defecto en Ajustes, y tenían que desplazarse hacia abajo para encontrar iOS 27, algo que la mayoría no hace. Ahora iOS 27.0.1 aparece como la opción destacada, relegando iOS 26.7.1 a una sección secundaria, lo que sugiere que Apple estaba retrasando deliberadamente la adopción para controlar el acceso a Siri AI mientras pulía la estabilidad del sistema.
body.en: Until recently, users on iOS 26 saw the latest iOS 26 version as the default suggested update in Settings, requiring a scroll down to find iOS 27 that most users never make. Now iOS 27.0.1 appears as the prominent update, relegating iOS 26.7.1 to a smaller section, suggesting Apple was deliberately slow-rolling adoption to gate access to Siri AI while polishing system stability.

evidence.claim: Apple is now suggesting iOS 27 to users still running iOS 26.
Until Thursday, the default suggested update for users on iOS 26.x was to remain on the latest version of iOS 26.
Apple is slow-rolling iOS 27 updates to gate access to Siri AI.
iOS 27 is remarkably stable with a focus on bug fixes and performance updates.

title.es: Los nuevos equipos Pro pasan a 30 días de retención por defecto
title.en: New Pro teams now default to 30-day deployment retention

text.es: Los nuevos equipos Pro tendrán por defecto un periodo de retención de despliegues de 30 días, lo que limita el historial antiguo y su coste de almacenamiento ($0.10 por GB-mes), aunque se puede ampliar en la configuración del equipo. Los despliegues eliminados bajo esta política no se pueden restaurar ni usar para rollback.
text.en: New Pro teams now default to a 30-day deployment retention period, limiting older history and its storage cost ($0.10 per GB-month), though teams can choose a longer period in settings. Deployments deleted under this policy cannot be restored or used for rollback.

evidence.claim: New Pro teams now default to a 30-day deployment retention period.
Shorter retention keeps recent history available while limiting older history and its storage costs.
You can choose a longer retention period in your team's settings when you need more history for inspection or rollback.
Deployment Storage and Functions Storage each cost $0.10 per GB-month.
Older deployments may be deleted under your retention policy. Deleted deployments cannot be restored or used for rollback.

title.es: X vuelve a marcar la diferencia frente a otras redes sociales
title.en: X once again marks the spot among social networks

text.es: Según un análisis, X ha "des-muskificado" silenciosamente su algoritmo, reduciendo la visibilidad de los propios tuits de Elon Musk, y su cultura se describe como sorprendentemente amigable. El autor sostiene que ve más contenido interesante en X que en Threads, Bluesky y Mastodon juntos, y señala que ejecutivos de Apple como Tim Cook o Greg Joswiak solo publican regularmente en esa plataforma.
text.en: According to one analysis, X has quietly de-Musked its algorithm, reducing the visibility of Elon Musk's own tweets, and its culture is described as surprisingly friendly. The author claims to see more interesting content on X than on Threads, Bluesky and Mastodon combined, and notes that Apple executives like Tim Cook and Greg Joswiak post regularly only on that platform.

evidence.claim: X has de-Musked its algorithm, reducing the visibility of Elon Musk's own tweets.
The culture on X is described as remarkably friendly and inclusive, contrasting with other platforms.
X is the only platform where Apple executives post regularly and exclusively.
There is more interesting content on X compared to other platforms like Threads, Bluesky, and Mastodon.
X has a larger user base compared to Bluesky and Mastodon.

title.es: macOS 27 mejora iPhone Mirroring con tres actualizaciones clave
title.en: macOS 27 brings three key upgrades to iPhone Mirroring

text.es: iOS 27 y macOS 27 Golden Gate, lanzados el mes anterior, incorporaron tres mejoras clave a la función iPhone Mirroring, que permite controlar el iPhone desde el Mac.
text.en: iOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, released the previous month, brought three key updates to the iPhone Mirroring feature that lets users control their iPhone from the Mac.

evidence.claim: iOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate were released last month.
Three key updates were brought to iPhone Mirroring.

title.es: Por qué AlphaFold no resolvió el plegamiento de proteínas
title.en: Why AlphaFold didn't solve protein folding

text.es: Investigadores de Google DeepMind y Biohub discuten que escalar cómputo y datos no basta para resolver todos los problemas biológicos, y que encontrar leyes de escalado específicas requiere trabajo propio. Argumentan que curar todas las enfermedades exige pensar en aceleraciones de 10x a 100x en el descubrimiento de fármacos, no en mejoras incrementales del 10%.
text.en: Researchers from Google DeepMind and Biohub argue that scaling compute and data alone isn't enough to solve every biology problem, and that finding specific scaling laws requires dedicated work. They contend that curing all disease requires thinking in terms of 10x–100x acceleration in drug discovery, not incremental 10% improvements.

evidence.claim: Scaling compute and data alone won't solve biology problems.
Curing all disease requires 10x breakthroughs rather than incremental improvements.

trending_repos.name: magpie
trending_repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

why_it_matters.es: Magpie ofrece una pasarela local única para usar distintos agentes de código (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) con distintos proveedores de modelos, rotando automáticamente de cuenta cuando se agota una cuota, algo útil para desarrolladores que combinan varias suscripciones de IA.
why_it_matters.en: Magpie provides a single local gateway to run different coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode) against different model providers, automatically rotating accounts when a quota runs out—useful for developers juggling multiple AI subscriptions.

trending_repos.name: talorys
trending_repos.description: Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.

why_it_matters.es: Talorys es un asistente de IA personal de código abierto que se despliega con un solo comando dentro de la propia cuenta de Cloudflare del usuario, sin servidores ni telemetría de terceros, ofreciendo memoria, tareas y recordatorios programados para un único usuario.
why_it_matters.en: Talorys is an open-source personal AI assistant that deploys with a single command inside the user's own Cloudflare account, with no third-party servers or telemetry, offering memory, tasks and scheduled reminders for a single user.

trending_repos.name: Herald-OS
trending_repos.description: An agent-native operating system, with Hermes Agent as the interface. Independent project, not affiliated with Nous Research.

why_it_matters.es: Herald OS es un sistema operativo construido en torno a un agente de IA (Hermes) que abre aplicaciones, organiza archivos y ejecuta rutinas programadas bajo un sistema de permisos controlado por el usuario, ilustrando hacia dónde evoluciona la interacción agente-sistema operativo.
why_it_matters.en: Herald OS is an operating system built around an AI agent (Hermes) that opens apps, organizes files and runs scheduled routines under a user-controlled permission system, illustrating where agent-OS interaction is heading.

trending_repos.name: abacusai-bot
trending_repos.description: 100% free, open-source personal agents for your messaging apps, tools, and services

why_it_matters.es: AbacusAI Bot permite crear agentes personales gratuitos y de código abierto que operan con permisos completos a través de WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord y servicios conectados como Gmail o GitHub, incluyendo tareas de programación, aunque sin el modo de aprobación de las sesiones supervisadas.
why_it_matters.en: AbacusAI Bot enables free, open-source personal agents that run with full tool permissions across WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord and connected services like Gmail or GitHub, including coding tasks, though without the approval mode used in supervised sessions.
